text: 2026年7月末，中央政治局会议定调下半年经济工作，明确宏观调控总体思路。随后国家发改委跟进发布相关政策并作出专项部署。本轮政策整体延续存量提质、结构微调的调控思路。在此背景下，市场围绕政策落地力度的博弈情绪持续升温。 针对本轮政策周期以及下半年经济、产业和资本市场走向，摩根士丹利中国首席经济学家邢自强给出系统性研判。他认为，本轮政策不会复刻2024年的全面宽松节奏，国内经济将延续典型的K型结构性分化特征。在其研判框架中，下半年稳增长的核心抓手来自可加快使用的两万多亿元财政余力，资金将重点向新基建与硬核科技领域倾斜。 产业层面，AI行业短期进入估值休整阶
text_en: At the end of July 2026, the Politburo meeting set the tone for H2 economic work, clarifying the overall macro-control approach. The NDRC subsequently followed up with relevant policies and special deployments. This policy round generally continues the control approach of improving existing stock quality and micro-adjusting structure. Against this backdrop, market sentiment around gaming the intensity of policy implementation keeps heating up. Regarding this policy cycle and the H2 outlook for the economy, industries, and capital markets, Morgan Stanley China Chief Economist Robin Xing offered a systematic assessment. He believes this round of policies will not replicate the broad easing pace of 2024, and the domestic economy will continue its typical K-shaped structural divergence. In his framework, the core lever for H2 stable growth comes from over 2 trillion yuan in fiscal headroom that can be used faster, with funds tilted toward new infrastructure and hardcore tech. At the industry level, AI enters a short-term valuation consolidation phase.
